_comment: Copy to drive.json. Pull *.swekupdate.json from one Drive folder (read-only). Use EITHER service-account OR oauth.
_mode_A_service_account: Headless. Make a service account in GCP, download its JSON key, set keyFile (or paste it into key).
Then SHARE your updates folder with the service account's client_email (Viewer).
_mode_B_oauth_personal_drive: Updates live in your own Drive. Make a Desktop-app OAuth client (clientId + clientSecret), put them in oauth below,
then run: node tools/drive-oauth-login.mjs   (opens a browser once; saves oauth.refreshToken here).
